description: This file defines an interface ITokenClaimsService in the ApplicationCore layer of the eShopOnWeb project, specifying a contract for asynchronously obtaining a token string given a username.

classes.name: ITokenClaimsService
classes.description: An interface for a service that provides token claims related functionalities, specifically obtaining a token asynchronously for a user.

methods.name: GetTokenAsync
methods.description: An asynchronous method that returns a token string associated with the provided username.
